author: Michael Larabel
description: With Linux 7.4 the AMDGPU driver enables HDMI 2.1 FRL functionality by default for driving higher refresh rate and higher resolution displays. That default enabling comes as HDMI FreeSync/VRR and ALLM features are also in place for Linux 7.4. Now coming by way of fixes for Linux 7.4 is also improving the Fixed Rate Link support with the newer HDMI 2.2 specification...
title: AMDGPU Driver Seeing HDMI 2.2 FRL Fixes For Linux 7.4

author: Michael Larabel
description: With Linux 7.4 the patches to speed-up the kernel build process began to land. This is the work that's yielded extremely fast incremental builds and noop builds. The patch series in full is also allowing kernel build times approaching just ten seconds with enough CPU cores. In today's article is a look at the Linux 7.3 vs. 7.4-rc1 build time performance on the Framework Laptop 13 Pro powered by Intel Panther Lake...
title: Linux 7.4's Build Time Performance From Optimizations But Also Larger Codebase

author: Michael Larabel
description: For those that use Linux's raid6check command for checking/repairing an MD RAID6 software RAID array's device for errors, newly-merged code is showing up to a 3x performance improvement...
title: Linux's RAID6 Check Tool Sees 3x Performance Via Batching

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Servo open-source browser engine project is finally out with their status report highlighting the improvements made back in September. There is expanded web compatibility, new HTML and JavaScript features, WebGL2 improvements, and continued work on expanding the embed capabilities of this engine...
title: Servo Browser Engine Continues Broadening Web Compatibility, New Features

author: Michael Larabel
description: A set of Linux kernel patches have been posted for review with a hope of reaching the mainline kernel to provide Apple AirDrop support for Macs equipped with the T2 chip...
title: Linux Kernel Patches Posted For Review In Enabling Apple AirDrop Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: Mir 2.31 is now available as the latest feature release for this Canonical/Ubuntu solution for providing C++ libraries to build Wayland-based shells...
title: Mir 2.31 Released With Expanded Wayland Protocol Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: New to the Linux 7.4 kernel cycle is the Core MM tree as the route for herding some of the core memory management Linux kernel patches to the mainline kernel rather than it all going through Andrew Morton's "MM" tree.  As the second pull request from this new kernel tree, a number of fixes were sent out today to address "nasty long-standing bugs" within the kernel...
title: Linux'x New Core MM Tree Ready With Numerous Fixes For "Nasty Long-Standing Bugs"

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged to Mesa 27.0-devel is a new common Vulkan layer within Mesa's Vulkan Runtime for being able to carry common game/engine/app workarounds that affect multiple drivers...
title: Mesa Merges A Common Vulkan Layer For Working Around Cross-Driver Game Bugs

author: Michael Larabel
description: The AMD-backed Lemonade local AI server shipped its version 2026.45.3 update on Wednesday that introduces a completely redesigned desktop app and web UI...
title: AMD-Backed Lemonade Local AI Server Ships Redesigned Desktop App & Web UI
